name: Linkdin Profile Scraper
description: LinkedIn Profile Scraper on viaSocket lets you turn publicly available LinkedIn profile pages into structured data you can use instantly in your workflows. Feed a list of profile URLs and automatically capture key fields like name, headline, company, title, location, summary, experiences, education, and profile image, then push them into Google Sheets, Airtable, HubSpot, Salesforce, and more, no code required. Built on viaSocket’s secure automation platform, it supports scheduling, rate limiting, retries, deduplication, and field mapping so your CRM and outreach tools stay clean and up to date. Important: Use only on data you’re permitted to access and always comply with LinkedIn’s Terms and applicable laws; where available, prefer official APIs or your authorized account access.

events.d: Extract key fields (name, headline, company, location, experience, education, image) from a public LinkedIn profile URL.
